question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
WITH all_customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) c
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month FROM customer_transactions) m
),
monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as deposits,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as withdrawals
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    acm.customer_id,
    acm.month,
    COALESCE(ma.deposits, 0) as deposits,
    COALESCE(ma.withdrawals, 0) as withdrawals,
    COALESCE(ma.deposits, 0) - COALESCE(ma.withdrawals, 0) as monthly_change
  FROM all_customer_months acm
  LEFT JOIN monthly_activity ma ON acm.customer_id = ma.customer_id AND acm.month = ma.month
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month,
    monthly_change,
    SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as closing_balance,
    SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as monthly_cumulative_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  month,
  monthly_change,
  closing_balance,
  monthly_cumulative_balance
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY customer_id, month
